Wait, `render` does `f"{header}:{value}"`. `header` is "legacy", so it returns `"legacy:test"`.
`encode_packet` does `f"{label.upper()}:{payload}"`. If `label` is "legacy", it returns `"LEGACY:test"`.
This is DIFFERENT.

So I cannot simply alias `render` to `encode_packet` if I want to keep the exact output of the client.
